tha-ap519:1.1: himavantassāvidūre vasalo nāma pabbato → himavantassa avidūre cāvalo nāmapabbato (bj) | himavantassāvidūre vasalo → himavantassa avidūre accalo (sya-all);  (pts)
tha-ap519:1.2: cāvalo → vasalo (bj: machasaṁ); accayo (bj: syā) | vasalo → cāvalo (cck: sī. pī.); accayo (cck: syā.)
tha-ap519:1.4: vasate → vasanto (sya-all) | vasate → G. vasati. (pts note)
tha-ap519:2.1: hemavantaṁ → hemavataṁ (bj, pts) | gayha → tayha (sya-all) | hemavataṁ → G. hemavantaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap519:3.2: katvāna añjaliṁ → katvānahantadā (sya-all, pts) | añjaliṁ → sīre katvānahaṁ tadā (bj: syā, PTS) | añjaliṁ → katvānahaṁ tadā (cck: syā. pī. ka.)
